howto.what: 给项目添加 Matrix 聊天通道:复制适配器、注册通道、安装并修补依赖,运行构建和测试,并引导填写机器人账号的登录信息或访问令牌。

howto.what_en: Adds Matrix channel support to the project: copies the Matrix adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned @beeper/chat-adapter-matrix package, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, then runs build and tests. Also prompts for bot account credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to integrate a Matrix channel, or during /setup when adding Matrix is required.

say_en.text: Add Matrix channel support to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and registers the channel

say_en.text: Integrate Matrix here using the method I give
say_en.note: Prompts for credentials and completes setup

say_en.text: Add Matrix support, then run build and tests
say_en.note: Runs the build and Matrix registration test
